items.title: Sonnet 5 launches: Opus performance at lower cost
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 5 在编程和智能体基准测试中达到 Opus 4.8 的性能水平，提供 50–67% 的成本降低，并在 8 月 31 日前保持 $2/$10 每百万 token 的定价。GitHub Copilot 现已原生集成至 JetBrains IDEs，通过 OAuth 认证即可使用，但需额外订阅费用。Google 的 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 模型上线 Vercel AI Gateway，单次 API 调用即可输出多模态内容，单价降至 $0.034 每张图像且延迟低于 4 秒。
items.why_now: Sonnet 5 今上线，8月31日前享半价可替代Opus。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 on the Vercel AI Gateway, offering Opus-level performance for coding and agentic tasks at a launch price of $2/$10 per million tokens, representing a 50–67% cost reduction. Concurrently, GitHub Copilot became a native agent in JetBrains IDEs, eliminating previous integration friction, while Google’s Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image model shipped for half the cost of its predecessor with sub-4-second latency.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一个基于 Claude Code 的开源视频编辑工具，通过集成 ElevenLabs Scribe 进行音频转录和自定义脚本实现自动剪辑、调色及字幕生成。其核心优势在于利用文本层而非直接处理视频帧，将 Token 消耗从数千万大幅降低至 12KB 文本加少量图片，从而高效完成精准剪接。
items.why_now: Browser Use发布开源视频编辑工具video-use
items.summary_en: Video-use is a 100% open-source tool that enables coding agents like Claude Code to edit raw video footage via natural language commands without the LLM processing visual frames directly. It achieves precise editing by utilizing ElevenLabs Scribe for word-level transcripts and selective visual composites, automating tasks such as cutting filler words, auto-color grading, and burning subtitles.

items.summary_en: Moonshot AI’s Kimi has reached a pre-money valuation of $31.5 billion, with its Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) surpassing $300 million, driven primarily by API usage which now accounts for over 70% of total income. In the robotics sector, YouiTech globally launched its FabriX industrial embodied AI model and humanoid robot, aiming to empower 10,000 industrial sites within three years based on its leading global market share in industrial mobile manipulation robots. Additionally, Samsung Electro-Mechanics secured a $293 million contract to supply multi-layer ceramic capacitors for AI servers from an undisclosed U.S. cloud provider through December 2027.

items.title: mattpocockuk 的 /writing-great-skills：编写可预测 AI Skill 的指南
items.summary: @mattpocockuk 发布的 writing-great-skills 旨在构建稳定触发的可预测工作流，通过区分 Model-invoked 与 User-invoked 触发成本及采用三层信息层级结构，有效解决上下文注意力稀释问题。该指南强调利用 leading word 压缩行为指令并设定明确的 completion criterion 以防止 premature completion，同时提供针对 Sediment、Sprawl 等常见失败模式的诊断方法。用户可通过 `npx skills add` 命令快速安装此 Skill 以优化 AI 技能编写的清晰度与执行稳定性。
items.why_now: GitHub作者新推可预测Skill编写指南，提升AI工作流稳定性。
items.summary_en: The `/writing-great-skills` repository by mattpocockuk provides a framework for creating predictable AI Skills that ensure stable behavior through structured triggers and clear completion criteria. It advocates for distinguishing between model-invoked and user-invoked skills, utilizing progressive disclosure to manage context attention, and employing "leading words" to compress behavioral requirements efficiently. The guide also includes diagnostic tools for common issues like premature completion and duplication to maintain clean, effective skill definitions.

items.title: Experience "Starting an App" with AI -0 experience, 2,900 users and community funded
items.summary: 作者利用Claude AI（$20方案）零代码构建“家庭农场分析”应用，通过Facebook免费自然流量获客，上线一个月即获得2,900名用户。该应用采用完全用户资助模式，无广告和付费墙，依靠约60名用户的月度捐赠及一次性礼物产生收益。目前月经常性收入达135美元，扣除71美元服务器及AI成本后，实现约220美元的净利润。
items.why_now: 零代码者用Claude月赚220美元，验证AI极速建站变现窗口。
items.summary_en: A non-coder built a homestead analytics app using Claude’s $20/month plan, acquiring 2,900 users within a month primarily through organic Facebook marketing. The project operates on a user-funded donation model, generating approximately $220 in profit against $71 in monthly operational costs by offering the app for free without ads or paywalls.

items.title: Have your agent record video demos of its work with shot-scraper video
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10版本新增video命令，利用Playwright和storyboard.yml文件自动化录制Web应用操作视频。该功能通过GPT-5.5生成YAML脚本，实现了如Datasette中批量插入CSV数据等复杂交互的演示录制。
items.why_now: shot-scraper 1.10 今日发布视频录制功能，助力AI Agent自动化生成工作演示。
items.summary_en: The shot-scraper 1.10 release introduces a video command that utilizes Playwright to record web application routines defined in a storyboard.yml file. This tool enables coding agents, such as those powered by GPT-5.5, to automatically generate video demonstrations of software features through structured YAML scripts.

items.title: What's new in Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，其性能接近Opus 4.8，具备100万token上下文窗口和默认启用的自适应思考功能。该模型采用新分词器，导致英文输入成本增加约30%（单价约为Sonnet 4.6的1.4倍），而简体中文成本基本持平。尽管定价名义不变，但实际因Token数量增加，整体调用费用在英文场景下显著上升。
items.why_now: Anthropic今早发布Sonnet 5，虽性能接近Opus但新分词器致成本增30%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, which offers performance comparable to Opus 4.8 at lower base prices but features a new tokenizer that increases token counts by approximately 30%, effectively raising costs for English and code inputs. Key technical specifications include a 1 million token context window, 128,000 maximum output tokens, and adaptive thinking enabled by default, while legacy sampling parameters like temperature are no longer supported.

items.title: Sonnet 5 review: I ran 64 generations to find out if it's worth it
items.summary: 作者通过自建的 How I AI Bench 基准测试，盲测对比了 Claude Sonnet 5 与 Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5 及 Gemini 3 Pro 在 PRD 质量、原型生成及代理任务完成等维度的表现。该评估采用 70% 人类主观评分结合 30% LLM 作为裁判的混合机制，并演示了如何利用 Claude Code 在 45 分钟内快速搭建此可复用测试框架。研究结果揭示了各模型在不同应用场景下的优劣，为开发者提供了具体的选型建议。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，独立开发者应即刻评估以抢占新模型红利窗口。
items.summary_en: The author evaluated Anthropic’s Sonnet 5 against Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, and Gemini 3 Pro using the "How I AI Bench," a repeatable evaluation harness built live with Claude Code. The assessment covered PRD quality, prototype generation, and agentic tasks, combining 70% human vibe scoring with 30% LLM-as-judge metrics to determine model suitability for specific workflows.

items.title: I Made TS Compiler Graph MCP: 10x Fewer Tokens in Claude Code
items.summary: Samchon 开发了基于 TypeScript 编译器构建的代码图索引库 @ttsc/graph，通过 MCP 协议向 AI 代理提供由编译器解析的节点与边关系，而非源代码正文。该方案在回答结构性问题时，相比传统文件遍历方式实现了约 10 倍的 Token 节省，且响应大小不随代码库规模增长而增加。测试基准显示，与其他竞品工具（如 codegraph、serena）不同，该方法在处理大型仓库时能保持稳定的低 Token 消耗。
items.why_now: 开源代码图工具发布，AI编程Token消耗骤减90%
items.summary_en: The @ttsc/graph tool leverages the TypeScript compiler to generate a dependency graph of nodes and edges, allowing coding agents to query structural relationships without accessing source code bodies. This approach reduces token usage by approximately 10 times compared to traditional file-grepping methods while maintaining answer accuracy. By providing exact file:line anchors verified by the compiler, it offers a scalable, low-overhead alternative to other MCP-based code intelligence solutions like codegraph and serena.

items.title: Bikin "Otak" AI Agent Bisa Diedit di Obsidian: Panduan Sinkronisasi Dua Arah untuk Pemula
items.summary: 本文介绍通过 Python 脚本将开源 AI Agent Hermes 的内存文件同步至 Obsidian，实现双向编辑与 Git 版本控制。该方案解决了原生 § 分隔格式难以维护和缺乏可视化的问题，确保用户能直观管理 USER、MEMORY 及 SOUL 等核心数据。系统无需额外依赖，仅用标准库即可在 Hermes 进程与 Obsidian 笔记库间自动转换并同步信息。
items.why_now: Hermes Agent 2026年2月发布，现支持双向同步至Obsidian。
items.summary_en: The article presents a synchronization solution for the Hermes Agent, an open-source AI framework by Nous Research, allowing users to edit its persistent memory files (USER.md, MEMORY.md, SOUL.md) directly in Obsidian. It utilizes a custom Python script that converts the agent's §-delimited format into structured Markdown with YAML frontmatter, enabling bidirectional updates and version control via Git. This approach resolves the limitations of Hermes' default "black box" memory by providing a visual, editable interface while maintaining data integrity across sessions.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute 是一个免费 AI 网关，通过单一端点连接 Claude Code、Cursor 等 16+ 编程工具至 236 个提供商（含 50+ 免费）。其利用 RTK+Caveman 堆叠压缩技术节省 15-95% 的 Token，并提供自动故障转移以确保持续运行。每月聚合文档免费 Token 约 16 亿，配合注册奖励可达 21 亿，且支持 MCP 和 A2A 协议。
items.why_now: OmniRoute发布，聚合236家提供商，提供1.6B免费Token。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that aggregates 236 providers, including 50+ with free tiers, into a single endpoint compatible with tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It utilizes RTK and Caveman stacked compression to save 15–95% of tokens and offers auto-fallback capabilities to ensure uninterrupted access to approximately 1.6 billion free tokens per month.

items.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice 是首款支持 macOS 端本地语音转文字及自定义 AI 增强的开源应用，其核心亮点在于集成了完全本地运行的 "Fluid Intelligence" 模型，实现零延迟的 Parakeet 语音识别及无需云端的智能格式化处理。该工具提供 Command 和 Write 双模式，支持 Nemotron、Whisper 等多引擎切换，并通过自适应主题和全局快捷键提升操作效率。
items.why_now: v1.6.0发布，Parakeet零延迟且支持本地AI增强。
items.summary_en: FluidVoice is an open-source macOS dictation app featuring the fastest on-device Parakeet speech-to-text engine and a local AI enhancement model called Fluid Intelligence for smart formatting. It supports multiple speech models, including Nemotron and Whisper, and offers Command and Write modes for voice-controlled automation and text generation.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.summary: AI Berkshire 是一套兼容 Claude Code 和 Codex 的价值投资研究框架，整合巴菲特、芒格等四大师方法论并通过多 Agent 并行对抗分析提升决策质量。该框架在 2024 年和 2025 年至今分别实现 +69.29% 和 +66.38% 的实盘收益，累计获利超 146 万元，大幅跑赢标普 500 及恒生指数等主要市场基准。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性信号
items.summary_en: AI Berkshire is an investment research framework compatible with Claude Code and Codex that systematizes the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu through multi-agent parallel analysis. It enforces strict decision discipline via adversarial perspectives, structured bias-reduction mechanisms, and precise financial calculations using Python's decimal module. The system achieved a 2024 return of +69.29%, significantly outperforming major indices like the S&P 500 and Hang Seng Index.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: herdr 是一款基于 Rust 开发的轻量级终端 Agent 多路复用器，旨在将多个编程 Agent 统一在单个终端窗口中管理，支持通过 SSH 远程连接及断线重连。该工具为每个 Agent 提供真实的终端视图以兼容全屏 TUI，并通过侧边栏实时展示 🔴阻塞、🟡工作中、🔵完成、🟢空闲等状态，无需额外配置即可实现可视化的工作流监控。与 tmux 或 GUI 管理器相比，herdr 优势在于其单二进制文件架构（约 10MB）、原生鼠标操作支持以及允许 Agent 通过 Socket API 进行编排的能力。
items.why_now: 刚发布支持多Agent终端管理的herdr工具，适合独立开发者提效。
items.summary_en: Herdr is a lightweight, single-binary Rust terminal multiplexer designed to manage multiple coding agents within real terminal sessions, offering features like persistent detach/reattach over SSH and mouse-native workspace organization. It provides immediate visibility into agent states (blocked, working, done) without requiring configuration hooks, distinguishing itself from traditional tools like tmux by integrating native agent awareness and orchestration capabilities.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人交易智能体，支持通过 WebSocket、Telegram 等 16 种消息适配器进行即时通讯运行时交互。该项目引入了 Broker-agnostic 的 PreTradeAdvisoryInterface 以增强实盘交易的安全性，并新增了 Trading 212 只读连接器及针对 Windows 和 Gemini 模型的修复。此外，系统优化了 Shadow Account 的条件入场逻辑（如 RSI 和前期回报率限制），并改进了多平台环境下的跨平台设置与文件沙箱安全性。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日新增IM渠道运行时，支持实时交易推送。
items.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent developed by HKUDS that empowers users with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command interface. The platform recently expanded its connectivity by adding support for 16 built-in message adapters, including Telegram, Slack, and Discord, alongside new broker integrations like Trading 212. It features robust safety mechanisms such as live advisory guards and cross-platform runtime stability enhancements to ensure secure and reliable automated trading operations.

items.title: AIEWF Daily Dispatch: Loops, Software Factories & Forward Deployed Engineers
items.summary: 在AI工程师世界博览会（AIEWF）上，“循环”成为核心议题，微软的Foundry与OpenAI的Codex等工具通过构建“学习循环”及多代理协作机制，显著提升了自动化生产力。演讲者提出“软件工厂”概念，旨在实现涵盖代码生成、反馈收集到部署的全生命周期自主开发，标志着软件工程向工厂化工程范式的转变。
items.why_now: AIEWF大会聚焦Agent自动化闭环与软件工厂，标志AI工程化进入新阶段。
items.summary_en: At the AI Engineer World’s Fair, speakers emphasized "loops" and "software factories" to automate the entire software development lifecycle using AI agents. Key platforms discussed included Microsoft’s Foundry and OpenAI’s Codex, which leverage persistent agent loops and human-in-the-loop workflows to enhance productivity beyond manual coding.

items.title: The twilight of the chatbots
items.summary: 美国前沿模型如Claude Fable和GPT-5.6在自主执行复杂软件项目方面展现出超越指数级的能力增长，例如Opus 4.7在14小时内完成了需2-17周人工的工作量。与此同时，中国推出的开放权重近前沿模型虽落后6-12个月，但凭借低成本优势也在快速提升性能，缩小了与闭源模型的差距。随着AI系统具备长程自主工作能力，人机协作模式正从频繁干预转向更少人工介入的自动化执行。
items.why_now: 美国顶尖模型遭政府临时禁入，市场窗口出现。
items.summary_en: Leading American AI labs like Anthropic and OpenAI are releasing frontier models such as Claude Fable and GPT-5.6 at an accelerating pace, demonstrating exponential gains in autonomous capabilities, including building software packages in hours that would take humans weeks. Concurrently, Chinese open-weight models are rapidly closing the gap, offering cost-effective alternatives that follow their own improvement curves despite generally lagging six to twelve months behind US proprietary systems.

items.title: Ahmad Osman on why local AI is catching up
items.summary: Ahmad Osman 通过其开源软件公司 Osmantic 及在 AI Engineer World’s Fair 的演示，展示了本地 AI 正在快速追赶闭源前沿模型，目前性能差距已缩小至四到八个月。他强调本地 AI 不仅是运行模型，还需整合搜索、工具及完整基础设施，并通过对比 DGX Spark、AMD Strix Halo 等硬件与云模型的实际表现，使该领域更具可信度。这一趋势吸引了从学生到企业高管的广泛关注，推动开发者将本地 AI 视为严肃的基础设施选项。
items.why_now: 今年AI工程师世界博览会上，本地AI正快速缩小与前沿模型差距。
items.summary_en: Ahmad Osman, founder of Osmantic, advocates for local AI as open-source LLMs rapidly close the performance gap with proprietary frontier models. His recent workshops at the AI Engineer World’s Fair demonstrated this shift by allowing attendees to benchmark local hardware, such as the DGX Spark and AMD Strix Halo, against cloud-based solutions. Osman emphasizes that successful local AI requires comprehensive infrastructure, including search endpoints and tool integration, rather than relying solely on the model itself.

items.title: I ported Kubernetes to the browser
items.summary: 该项目名为Webernetes，成功将Kubernetes移植至浏览器环境运行。其核心能力在于无需后端服务器即可在客户端提供完整的K8s集群管理体验，与依赖远程连接的传统方案形成鲜明对比。
items.summary_en: Webernetes is a project that ports Kubernetes to the browser, enabling users to run a fully functional Kubernetes cluster via web interfaces. This implementation allows for the management of containerized applications directly within a browser environment, as demonstrated by the live demo at webernetes-demo.ngrok.app.

items.title: shot-scraper 1.10
items.summary: shot-scraper 发布 1.10 版本，新增核心功能支持通过 storyboard.yml 文件进行视频录制。该更新允许用户利用脚本化配置，自动化记录演示视频的工作流程。
items.why_now: 发布支持视频故事板功能
items.summary_en: shot-scraper version 1.10 introduces a new feature allowing users to create video storyboards via `shot-scraper video storyboard.yml`. This update enables agents to automatically record video demonstrations of their operational workflows.

items.title: Claude Science
items.summary: Claude Science 是 Anthropic 推出的专注于科学推理的产品，旨在通过强化模型在数学、物理和化学等领域的复杂问题解决能力，显著提升其在STEM任务中的准确率。该工具利用先进的思维链技术和大规模科学数据微调，使模型能够处理多步骤推导和公式验证，从而在专业科学基准测试中超越现有通用语言模型的表现。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Science，专注科学领域，提升复杂推理能力。
items.summary_en: Claude Science is a specialized model from Anthropic designed to enhance scientific reasoning and problem-solving capabilities. It integrates advanced logical deduction and domain-specific knowledge to assist researchers in complex analytical tasks.

items.title: Show HN: ChDB-WASM – ClickHouse running in the browser via WebAssembly
items.summary: ChDB-WASM 利用 WebAssembly 技术在浏览器端运行 ClickHouse 数据库引擎。该方案实现了客户端本地数据处理能力，无需依赖后端服务器即可执行复杂的 SQL 查询与分析。
items.why_now: ChDB-WASM刚发布，支持浏览器运行ClickHouse。
items.summary_en: ChDB-WASM enables ClickHouse database functionality to run directly within web browsers using WebAssembly technology. This approach allows for client-side data processing without requiring server-side infrastructure, leveraging ClickHouse's columnar storage engine in a browser environment.

items.title: Show HN: Sibyl – self-hosted cross-agent memory for AI coding agents
items.summary: Sibyl 是一款基于 SurrealDB 构建的高性能、可扩展的自托管跨代理内存系统，旨在为并行运行的 AI 编码代理提供共享知识基底。其核心优势在于无需 LLM 参与检索路径即可实现 96.96% 的严格 recall@5 准确率，支持通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议接入各类代理，并兼容 Docker 及 Kubernetes 部署环境。该项目已发布 v1.0.2 版本，采用 Apache 2.0 开源协议，允许用户将项目笔记、文档及邮件等数据本地化存储以实现上下文连贯性。
items.why_now: 作者刚发布1.0.2版本，开源自托管AI记忆系统上线
items.summary_en: Sibyl is a self-hosted, open-source cross-agent memory system built on SurrealDB that enables high-performance parallel coding through CLI or MCP integration. It achieves a competitive 96.96% strict recall@5 on LongMemEval-S via RAG without an LLM in the retrieval path, allowing agents to instantly access project context and stored notes.

items.title: Show HN: Coding agent that compiles intent into deterministic DAG before running
items.summary: Rigorix 是一种编码智能体，其核心技术在于运行前将用户意图编译为确定性的有向无环图（DAG）。该方案通过结构化执行流程，显著提升了代码生成的确定性与可靠性，优于传统随机性较强的生成式方法。
items.why_now: Rigorix开源，将编码意图转化为确定性DAG
items.summary_en: Rigorix is a coding agent that compiles user intent into a deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) prior to execution. This approach ensures structured, predictable code generation by separating intent analysis from the actual coding process.

items.title: ScarfBench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Enterprise Java Framework Migration
items.summary: ScarfBench是一个用于评估AI智能体在企业Java框架迁移任务中表现的基准测试。该研究重点考察了智能体在处理复杂企业级代码重构时的核心能力，并与传统手动迁移或基础自动化方案进行了对比分析。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性
items.summary_en: ScarfBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in migrating enterprise Java frameworks. It focuses on assessing the technical proficiency and accuracy of automated tools in handling complex legacy code transitions.

items.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
items.summary: Etched作为英伟达的AI芯片竞争对手，其估值已达到50亿美元。该公司凭借搭载自研芯片的推理系统，已签订价值10亿美元的合同。
items.why_now: Etched芯片获$10亿订单，估值$50亿，AI芯片竞争加剧。
items.summary_en: Etched, a competitor to Nvidia in the AI chip market, has achieved a $5 billion valuation after booking $1 billion in contracts for its inference systems. These systems are powered by Etched's proprietary chips, marking significant commercial traction in the artificial intelligence hardware sector.

items.title: X now offers an MCP server to make its platform easier for AI tools to use
items.summary: X推出了托管式MCP服务器，旨在降低开发者将AI应用接入其API的门槛。该举措通过标准化的Model Context Protocol简化了平台连接流程，提升了AI工具对X数据的访问效率。
items.why_now: X刚发布MCP服务器，降低AI接入门槛，开发者需关注此新机遇。
items.summary_en: X has launched a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to streamline connections between AI applications and its platform API. This release aims to simplify integration for developers seeking to leverage X's services within their AI tools.

items.title: AI Metrics Baseline: Prove Your Feature Works Before Scaling It
items.summary: 文章提出建立AI指标基线以验证功能价值，建议从成本、质量等五个维度选取关键指标进行前后对比。例如支持机器人应追踪解决率、引用质量和单次解决成本，而RAG搜索则需评估答案依据性、检索精度及来源时效性。通过量化这些具体数据，团队能基于客观事实而非主观印象做出是否扩展或优化功能的决策。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性
items.summary_en: Establishing an AI metrics baseline is essential to objectively evaluate feature performance, cost efficiency, and quality before scaling. Teams should track five key categories—cost, quality, speed, adoption, and business impact—using specific indicators like cost per successful task, groundedness, and resolution rates to replace subjective opinions with measurable data.

items.title: Sonnet 5 ships as Washington frees Fable
items.summary: Anthropic发布Sonnet 5，其知识工作能力超越Opus 4.8并具备更强的代理编程功能，API定价为每百万输入/输出令牌2/10美元至3/15美元。Google推出Nano Banana 2 Lite和Gemini Omni Flash模型，前者以0.034美元/张的价格快速生成图像，后者能以0.10美元/秒的成本生成和编辑视频。
items.why_now: Anthropic Sonnet 5 API降价至8月31日，且Fable解禁在即。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Sonnet 5, a mid-tier model with enhanced agentic coding and reasoning capabilities, though it lags in cybersecurity compared to its predecessor. This launch coincides with the impending return of the more powerful Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models following the lifting of U.S. export controls. Meanwhile, Google introduced the cost-effective Nano Banana 2 Lite for image generation and the Gemini Omni Flash model for high-speed video creation and editing.

items.title: Free AI Gateway for Developers: A Game Changer for Coding Productivity
items.summary: diegosouzapw在GitHub上发布了免费的AI网关，提供统一端点以接入超过231家AI提供商，其中包含50多个免费选项。该工具支持Claude Code、Codex等主流模型，具备智能自动故障转移和多媒体API功能，并通过Node.js示例展示了具体的集成方式。尽管存在潜在的延迟增加及免费版限制等权衡因素，其简化集成流程的能力仍显著提升了开发者的编码效率。
items.why_now: diegosouzapw刚在GitHub发布支持231家提供商的免费AI网关。
items.summary_en: Diegosouzapw’s free AI gateway on GitHub offers a single endpoint for accessing over 231 AI providers, including 50+ free options, to streamline developer integrations. Key features include smart auto-fallback mechanisms and support for multimodal APIs, allowing seamless switching between services like Claude Code and Copilot. While it simplifies infrastructure management, users should consider potential latency increases and free-tier limitations when scaling applications.

items.title: How to Write a Pull Request Description with AI
items.summary: 通过执行 `git diff` 命令提取代码变更并配合指定 Prompt，利用 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具自动生成包含变更摘要、动机、测试步骤及注意事项的结构化 PR 描述。该流程将原本耗时较长的描述撰写时间缩短至 2-3 分钟，并将结果保存至 `.github/pull_request_template.md` 以统一团队标准，从而显著提升代码审查效率。
items.why_now: 无明确时效信号，输出为空。
items.summary_en: The article outlines a four-step workflow using AI to generate high-quality Pull Request descriptions, starting with extracting the code diff via `git diff`. It provides a specific prompt instructing the AI to structure the output into "What changed," "Why," "How to test," and "Notes for reviewer" sections based on the raw diff. Saving this structure as a `.github/pull_request_template.md` file standardizes the process, reducing writing time from 15 minutes to under two minutes per PR.

items.title: Building an Identity System for AI Agents: AgentCard and Work Records
items.summary: Octo 是一个开源项目，通过引入 AgentCard 和 Work Records 为 AI Agent 建立持久身份与工作历史。该系统利用 Matter 机制记录任务交付与反馈，生成 Preference Cards 以迭代优化 Agent 表现，并支持六种协作模式。
items.why_now: Octo开源，为AI代理提供身份与工作记录基础设施。
items.summary_en: Octo is an open-source Apache 2.0 project that provides AI agents with persistent identities through Bots, AgentCards, and detailed work histories. It utilizes a "Matter" system to structure tasks, track acceptance or rejection, and generate Preference Cards that iteratively improve bot performance based on team feedback.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix 是一款开源 AI 渗透测试工具，具备多智能体编排能力，能动态运行代码并生成包含工作概念验证（PoC）的真实漏洞验证结果。它支持通过 GitHub Actions 和 CI/CD 流水线集成，提供一键自动修复功能及合规报告，显著减少静态分析工具常见的误报问题。
items.why_now: Strix刚集成GitHub Actions，可自动在PR中扫描漏洞。
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source autonomous AI penetration testing tool that dynamically identifies and validates application vulnerabilities using multi-agent orchestration and real proof-of-concept exploits. It integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions to block insecure code before production while offering automated patch generation and compliance-ready reporting. The platform supports various LLM providers and provides a comprehensive toolkit including HTTP interception, browser exploitation, and static/dynamic code analysis.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: 该数据集包含 1,324 项健身动作，提供英、西、意、土、俄、中 6 种语言的步骤说明及详细的肌肉群、器械和分类元数据。数据源自 ExerciseDB v1，虽未捆绑媒体文件，但保留了 media_id 以供引用，并附带交互式浏览器和开发者设置向导。
items.why_now: 健身应用开发者可用此开源数据集快速搭建后端，节省数据获取成本。
items.summary_en: The hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset provides a structured collection of 1,324 fitness exercises with metadata including target muscle groups, equipment requirements, and step-by-step instructions translated into six languages. Derived from ExerciseDB v1, the repository excludes media assets due to ownership conflicts but retains media IDs for reference. It also includes an interactive client-side browser and developer setup tools to facilitate building fitness applications or ML models.

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.summary: google/agents-cli 是一套命令行工具和技能集，可将 Claude Code、Codex 等任意编程助手转化为在 Google Cloud 上构建和部署 AI Agent 的专家。它通过提供项目脚手架、基于 ADK Python API 的开发、评估优化及一键部署至 Cloud Run/GKE 等全生命周期支持，简化了企业级 Agent 的创建与管理流程。
items.why_now: Google发布agents-cli，助力独立开发者快速构建部署企业级AI Agent。
items.summary_en: The `google-agents-cli` is a command-line tool and skill set that integrates with coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex to streamline the creation, evaluation, and deployment of AI agents on Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. It provides specialized commands for scaffolding projects, running automated evaluations with adaptive rubrics, and deploying infrastructure via Cloud Run or GKE, eliminating the need for manual CLI management. Compatible with Python 3.11+ and Node.js, the tool enhances development workflows by embedding agent lifecycle governance directly into the coding environment.

items.title: 卡帕西李飞飞辛顿都投了的Transformer专用芯片，签下10亿美元大单
items.summary: 该文章未提供具体正文内容，无法提取关于Transformer专用芯片的10亿美元订单细节、核心技术能力或与现有方案的对比等关键事实。

items.summary_en: The Transformer-specialized chip company, backed by investors including Fei-Fei Li and Geoffrey Hinton, has secured a $1 billion contract. This significant deal highlights the growing demand for specialized hardware optimized for Transformer architectures. The investment underscores the strategic importance of dedicated AI accelerators in scaling large language model applications.

items.title: 秋声 | 31岁学霸冲港股IPO，李泽湘成最大赢家
items.summary: 本末动力以18C特专科技公司身份冲刺港股IPO，核心产品为机器人直驱动力模组，2025年出货量超500万套，占据中国消费机器人直驱细分市场61.1%的领先地位。公司2025年营收达2.82亿元，其中直驱模组收入2.48亿元，但受限于21.5%的综合毛利率及85.7%的客户集中度，经调整净亏损率为15.4%。创始人张笛及李泽湘系资本通过早期低价入股成为主要受益者，累计融资约6.48亿元，估值约12倍市销率对标上市标准。
items.why_now: 本末动力6月底过会，直驱模组赛道2026-2030年预计48.6%高增。
items.summary_en: Be-Motion Technology, a direct-drive force module supplier for consumer robots, passed the Hong Kong Stock Exchange hearing under the 18C chapter, planning to issue approximately 122 million H shares with CITIC Securities (Hong Kong) as the sole sponsor. The company reported a surge in revenue to 282 million RMB in 2025 and holds a 61.1% market share in China’s consumer robot direct-drive module segment, having shipped over 5 million units globally. Founder Zhang Di and key investors linked to Professor Li Zexiang stand to gain significantly from the IPO, leveraging the firm's position as the sole global provider of such modules exceeding 5 million shipments in the consumer robotics sector.

items.title: 胡彦斌，你以后Vibe Coding 不用抱电脑了
items.summary: Cursor 推出 iOS 版 App 及 OpenClaw 发布 iOS 和 Android 原生应用，标志着编程 Agent 从电脑端向移动端延伸。这些工具通过云端远程控制和异步审批机制，让用户能在手机上监控任务进度、查看 Diff 并下达指令，实现了“AI 持续工作、人类按需介入”的新交互模式。此举旨在打破对物理设备的依赖，模糊手机与 PC 的工作场景界限，使 Agent 不再要求用户时刻守在电脑前。
items.why_now: Cursor及OpenClaw近期相继发布手机App，重塑人机协作模式。
items.summary_en: Cursor has released an iOS app that allows users to launch cloud-based coding agents and manage tasks remotely via push notifications, diffs, and voice input, though it requires a paid subscription. Simultaneously, OpenClaw launched native iOS and Android apps that integrate mobile hardware capabilities like cameras and location services into its personal AI assistant workflow. These developments signal a shift toward asynchronous human-AI collaboration where agents work continuously while users intervene only for approvals and key decisions.

items.title: 美团 LongCat-2.0 正式发布：国产算力集群训练的万亿参数大模型
items.summary: 美团发布并开源了基于五万卡国产算力集群训练的万亿参数大模型LongCat-2.0，该模型采用ScMoE及MOPD多专家融合架构，原生支持1M超长上下文。在技术评测中，其SWE-bench Pro得分达59.5，SWE-bench Multilingual得分达77.3，展现出强大的代码与多语言能力。目前预览版已通过OpenRouter和longcat.ai开放，月调用量已跻身OpenRouter全球前三。
items.why_now: 6月30日美团发布万亿参数大模型并开源，提供国产算力替代方案。
items.summary_en: Meituan has open-sourced LongCat-2.0, a 1.6 trillion-parameter large language model trained on a domestic cluster of 50,000 GPUs, featuring native support for 1 million token context windows. The model utilizes advanced architectures including LSA sparse attention and ScMoE, achieving strong performance metrics such as 59.5 on SWE-bench Pro. It is currently accessible via preview through OpenRouter and longcat.ai, where it ranks in the top three globally for monthly API calls.

items.title: Acti 将 AI 智能体直接放入手机键盘
items.summary: Acti 推出基于 Google Gemini 的 AI 智能体键盘，通过本地优先架构保护隐私，允许用户利用自然语言创建如长按 T 键翻译等快捷操作 Skills。该产品在早期测试中两周内即促成超 1000 个 Skills 的创建，目前已在获得 530 万美元种子轮融资后开放下载。
items.why_now: Acti今日上线，AI智能体直接嵌入手机键盘，独立开发者需关注此新交互范式。
items.summary_en: Singapore-based startup Acti has launched an AI agent keyboard powered by Google Gemini, enabling users to execute app actions via natural language shortcuts called Skills. The tool utilizes a local-first architecture for privacy and saw over 1,000 Skills created by early testers within two weeks. Acti recently secured $5.3 million in seed funding led by BITKRAFT Ventures and has made the keyboard available for download.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 发布
items.summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，具备计划、浏览器和终端自主运行能力，在推理、编程及智能体任务上显著优于 Sonnet 4.6。该模型定价极具竞争力，即日起至 2026 年 8 月 31 日输入输出价格分别为 $2/百万和 $10/百万，性能接近 Opus 4.8 且幻觉更少。目前 Claude Sonnet 5 已全面上线，适用于所有套餐、Claude Code 及 Claude API。
items.why_now: Anthropic 今起发布 Claude Sonnet 5 并限时降价至 2026 年 8 月。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, an autonomous agent model with planning, browser, and terminal capabilities that significantly outperforms Sonnet 4.6 on BrowseComp and OSWorld-Verified benchmarks while approaching Opus 4.8’s performance at a lower cost of $2/$10 per million input/output tokens until August 2026. The model is now available across all plans, Claude Code, and the Claude API, offering improved safety metrics with reduced hallucinations despite weaker cybersecurity capabilities compared to Opus 4.8.

items.title: Claude Code 入门：智能体循环
items.summary: Claude Code 定义了四种智能体循环类型：turn-based、goal-based、time-based 及 proactive 循环，分别支持用户触发、目标验证、定时执行及事件驱动模式。文章重点介绍了通过编写 SKILL.md 文件将人工验证步骤编码，使 Claude 能进行端到端自检。这一机制有效减少了 turn-based 循环中的手动干预，提升了自动化效率。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Code智能体循环功能
items.summary_en: Claude Code defines agent loops as repetitive processes until a stop condition is met, categorizing them into turn-based, goal-based, time-based, and proactive types. Goal-based loops use the `/goal` command for verifiable standards, while time-based loops utilize `/loop` and `/schedule` for interval execution. The tool also supports `SKILL.md` files to encode manual verification steps for end-to-end self-checking.

items.title: ADK Go 2.0 发布：构建可靠的多智能体应用，新增基于图的工作流引擎、人工参与循环与动态编排
items.summary: Go 版 Agent Development Kit (ADK) 2.0 发布，核心引入基于图的工作流引擎以支持复杂多智能体应用组合。该版本新增人工参与循环（HITL）、纯 Go 代码动态执行及指数退避重试等特性，并通过统一执行模型简化了遥测与状态持久化。
items.why_now: Google 刚发布 Go SDK 2.0，新增图工作流引擎。
items.summary_en: Google released ADK for Go 2.0, introducing a graph-based workflow engine to orchestrate complex multi-agent applications within a unified runtime. The update features human-in-the-loop (HITL) capabilities, pure Go dynamic execution, and automatic resilience via exponential backoff retries. This consolidation simplifies telemetry and state persistence for both single-agent and graph-based workflows.

items.title: 用 shot-scraper video 让 AI 智能体录制工作演示视频
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 新增 video 命令，基于 Playwright 1.61.0 的 screencast 机制，通过 storyboard.yml 定义步骤解决视频录制中的白帧和分辨率问题。该功能支持 AI 编码 Agent 直接调用以自动生成如 Datasette 创建数据表等操作的工作演示视频。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日shot-scraper 1.10发布，新增视频录制功能。
items.summary_en: Shot-scraper 1.10 introduces the `shot-scraper video` command, leveraging Playwright 1.61.0’s new screencast mechanism to record browser demonstrations via `storyboard.yml` files. This update resolves prior issues such as white frames and fixed 800px width, enabling coding agents to automatically generate demo videos based on detailed help output.

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash
items.summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite，作为速度最快且成本最低的图像模型，其文本转图像仅需 4 秒，每 1K 分辨率图像成本为 0.034 美元，并已在 Google AI Studio 及 Gemini App 等产品上线。同时推出的 Gemini Omni Flash 支持高画质视频生成与对话式编辑，视频输出定价为每秒 0.10 美元，目前已面向开发者开放 API。
items.why_now: Gemini新API刚上线，视频生成成本降至每秒$0.10。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Nano Banana 2 Lite, its fastest and lowest-cost image model at $0.034 per 1K resolution image with 4-second generation times, available via Google AI Studio and consumer products. Concurrently, they launched Gemini Omni Flash, an API-accessible model for high-quality video generation and conversational editing priced at $0.10 per second.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio 更新：更智能、更快速、更互联
items.summary: Apple Creator Studio 更新引入多项设备端 AI 功能，包括 Final Cut Pro 的 Generate Captions 与 Edit Detection，以及 Mac 版的 Auto Mask 和增强的 Match Color。该套件强化了应用间互联，支持向 Pixelmator Pro 发送帧并直接在 Keynote、Pages 中调用其修图能力。订阅价格为每月 $12.99 或每年 $129，新用户可享一个月免费试用。
items.why_now: 2026年6月苹果发布Creator Studio更新，新增AI功能。
items.summary_en: Apple Creator Studio introduces on-device AI features across its suite, including Final Cut Pro’s Generate Captions and Edit Detection, Mac’s Auto Mask, and Logic Pro’s enhanced Chord ID. Users can now seamlessly edit frames in Pixelmator Pro directly from Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. The subscription is priced at $12.99/month or $129/year, with a free month trial for new users and $2.99/month for education.

items.title: GPT-5.6 is here but...
items.summary: Etched 已完成首款芯片在台积电 4nm 工艺上的首次流片成功（A0），并已获得 8 亿美元融资及超 10 亿美元的积压订单。该公司通过芯片、机架、软件到制造的全栈垂直整合，旨在解决 AI 推理领域的延迟、成本和功耗瓶颈。OpenAI 方面，GPT-5.6 及其子模型 Sol 已发布，但受美国政府限制仅对“选定合作伙伴”开放。
items.summary_en: Etched, a newly revealed AI inference hardware company, has secured $800 million and holds over $1 billion in backlog orders, achieving successful A0 chip production on TSMC’s 4nm process within under three years. Concurrently, OpenAI faces US government restrictions on launching GPT-5.6, which includes the Sol, Terra, and Luna models, limiting initial access to select partners.

items.title: [AINews] Sonnet 5 today, and Fable 5 tomorrow
items.summary: Anthropic 发布全新中端前沿模型 Claude Sonnet 5，其上下文窗口达 100 万 token，被定位为最具代理能力的 Sonnet 版本，支持自主规划及浏览器/终端工具调用。尽管官方维持 3美元/百万输入和 15美元/百万输出的标准定价，但在 8月31日前提供 2美元/10美元的促销费率。与此同时，备受关注的 Fable 5 模型虽已获政府批准，但暂未随 Sonnet 5 同步上线，导致市场出现预期落差。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, its new default mid-tier model featuring a 1M-token context window and enhanced agentic capabilities for coding and tool use. While maintaining standard pricing at $3/M input and $15/M output tokens, the company introduced a promotional rate of $2/$10 until late August or early September. The release coincides with platform expansions like Linux support and Managed Agents updates, despite earlier market speculation regarding a simultaneous release of the restricted Fable 5 model.

items.title: Tell HN: Installing Cursor on iOS irreversibly changes your privacy settings
items.summary: 安装 Cursor iOS 应用并登录时，系统会自动将账户隐私模式从“Privacy Mode (Legacy)”更改为允许存储代码的当前版本，且该选项在界面中消失无法找回。官方客服承认此设计缺陷，表示无法恢复至旧版隐私设置，仅承诺改进提示清晰度。建议注重数据隐私的用户避免安装或配置该应用，以防隐私设置被不可逆地修改。
items.summary_en: Installing the Cursor iOS app automatically downgrades users' privacy settings from "Privacy Mode (Legacy)" to a less secure mode that allows code storage for background agents, with no option to revert the change. Support confirmed this irreversible switch occurs during setup due to a misleading prompt, effectively removing the legacy privacy option from all menus.

items.title: Show HN: Abstractions – Weekly newsletters explaining your codebase
items.summary: Abstractions 是一款能自动索引代码库并每周向团队发送功能解析简报的工具，无需用户主动提问即可通过理解代码自动生成主题。该应用支持 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型（BYOK），仅存储代码嵌入和高阶摘要而不保留原始代码，目前处于免费阶段。
items.summary_en: Abstractions is a self-initiated tool that indexes codebases to generate weekly newsletters explaining functionalities without requiring user queries. It utilizes embeddings and high-level summaries rather than storing raw code, supporting both Anthropic and OpenAI models via a BYOK setup.

items.title: Show HN: Erlangchain – A tiny Erlang client for LLMs
items.summary: Erlangchain 是一个轻量级 Erlang 库，支持调用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的大语言模型。该客户端无需第三方依赖，提供简易聊天 API、基础工具使用及多模态消息支持。
items.summary_en: Erlangchain is a lightweight Erlang library that enables direct integration with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs without requiring third-party dependencies. It supports core functionalities including a simple chat API, basic tool use, and multimodal message handling.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.summary: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 通过隐写术在请求中嵌入标记，用于追踪用户身份及防止提示词注入攻击。该机制将识别信息隐藏在代码注释或空白字符中，对用户透明且不影响功能执行。这一技术旨在增强 API 使用的安全性与合规性，区别于传统的显式日志记录方案。
items.summary_en: Claude Code steganographically embeds user-specific identifiers within prompt requests to track and attribute usage back to individual customers. This technique allows Anthropic to monitor how different users interact with the tool, potentially aiding in abuse detection or personalized service improvements. The method operates invisibly, ensuring that the embedded data does not disrupt the functionality of the AI model's responses.

items.title: Show HN: World Model MCP v0.10.0 – cross-runtime memory across 7 coding agents
items.summary: World Model MCP v0.10.0 是一个开源项目，实现了跨运行时环境在 7 个编码代理之间的共享记忆功能。该工具通过 MCP 协议增强了多智能体协作能力，解决了不同代码执行环境间的信息隔离问题。
items.summary_en: World Model MCP v0.10.0 enables cross-runtime memory synchronization for seven distinct coding agents, facilitating persistent context sharing across different development environments. This tool allows agents to maintain consistent state and knowledge bases regardless of their underlying runtime implementations.

items.title: Show HN: Live face swap and outfit try-on in the browser
items.summary: 该工具展示了在浏览器端实时进行人脸替换和服装试穿的技术能力。它实现了无需后端服务器即可在客户端完成复杂的视觉处理功能。
items.summary_en: Vivify.video introduces a browser-based tool enabling real-time face swapping and virtual outfit try-ons without requiring server-side processing. The platform leverages client-side AI inference to deliver these visual modifications directly within the user's web environment.

items.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
items.summary: Wayve以85亿美元的估值启动了8500万美元的员工要约收购，旨在通过该战略吸引和留住人才。此举反映了AI初创企业利用员工要约作为人才管理工具的日益增长的趋势。
items.summary_en: Wayve has launched an $85 million employee tender offer at an $8.5 billion valuation, leveraging this financial mechanism to attract and retain talent within the competitive AI startup landscape.

items.title: Amazon launches new $1 billion FDE org, following OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: 亚马逊推出新的10亿美元FDE组织，旨在效仿OpenAI和Anthropic的战略步伐。该团队工程师将嵌入客户公司内部部署定制化代理，重点提升部署速度及客户自主性。
items.summary_en: Amazon has launched a new $1 billion Foundry Developer Engagement (FDE) organization to support its AI initiatives. The team’s engineers will embed within client companies to deploy purpose-built agents, prioritizing rapid implementation and customer self-sufficiency. This move follows similar organizational shifts by competitors OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: Claude Science is Anthropic’s newest flagship product
items.summary: Anthropic推出旗舰产品Claude Science，旨在通过自主执行代码运行及集群管理等工具，支持计算生物学和药物研发等科学工作。该独立产品强调结果的可复现性，其能力被评估为相当于二年级研究生水平，并计划用于罕见病药物研究。此举标志着Anthropic在AI科学领域发力，试图接替DeepMind在该领域的领先地位。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Science, a standalone product for paid subscribers designed to autonomously support scientific research in computational biology and drug development. The tool enhances productivity by enabling users to write and run code on powerful computer clusters while prioritizing result reproducibility. This release positions Anthropic to compete with Google DeepMind, leveraging recent talent acquisitions like former DeepMind researcher John Jumper.

items.title: ♟️ Why Can’t Incumbents Copy You (Even When They Obviously Should)?
items.summary: 文章指出 incumbent 难以复制初创企业，因为模仿会损害其现有商业模式并暴露其市场误判，因此建议通过攻击对手商业模型和锚定真实客户需求进行“反向定位”。同时推荐了 AI 成本优化策略及 HeadsUp 等竞争情报工具，并分享了 Gary Klein 提出的“事前验尸”决策练习以识别潜在风险。
items.summary_en: Incumbents struggle to copy successful startups because doing so would damage their existing business models and force them to admit prior market misjudgments. Effective counter-positioning requires anchoring a new model to genuine customer needs while attacking the incumbent's profitability through strategies like lower fees or superior value.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Astryx 是一个基于 React 和 StyleX 构建的开源设计系统，源自 Meta 内部，已支撑 13,000+ 应用并提供 150+ 个可访问组件。该系统通过开放内部结构、无样式锁定及统一的人机协作 API，实现了高度的可定制性与对 AI 助手的原生支持。用户可通过安装 `@astryxdesign/core` 和 `@astryxdesign/cli` 包，利用预建 CSS 和类型化组件快速集成，无需额外配置构建插件。
items.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source React design system, currently in beta and built on StyleX, which powers over 13,000 applications within Meta. It provides 150+ accessible components, seven customizable themes, and a dedicated CLI, enabling both human developers and AI agents to build using the same cohesive tooling.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.summary: LingBot-Map 是由 Robbyant 团队开发的基于前馈架构的 3D 基础模型，通过几何上下文变换器统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索及长程漂移校正。该模型利用分页 KV 注意力机制，在 518×378 分辨率下对超过 10,000 帧的长序列实现约 20 FPS 的稳定流式推理。其在 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 等基准测试中展现了优于现有流式及迭代优化方法的重建性能。
items.summary_en: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model by the Robbyant Team that achieves stable streaming inference at approximately 20 FPS for sequences exceeding 10,000 frames using a Geometric Context Transformer with paged KV cache attention. The model unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction to deliver state-of-the-art reconstruction performance on diverse benchmarks.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Microsoft发布的“AI for Beginners”课程提供为期12周、共24课的系统化教学，涵盖TensorFlow和PyTorch等主流框架及神经网络架构。该资源支持50多种语言翻译，并采用GoFAI、遗传算法等多维度AI方法，旨在为初学者提供从理论到伦理的全面入门指导。
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s AI-For-Beginners is a comprehensive 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum designed to teach Artificial Intelligence fundamentals, covering neural networks, deep learning, and ethical considerations. The program utilizes practical labs and code examples in popular frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch, while explicitly excluding classic machine learning and cloud-specific tools. It supports global accessibility through automated multi-language translations for over 50 languages and offers efficient cloning methods for large-scale downloads.

items.title: 视频版Nano Banana来了！内置Gemini世界知识；原版香蕉出图仅需4秒
items.summary: 视频版Nano Banana内置Gemini世界知识，原版香蕉出图仅需4秒。
items.summary_en: Nano Banana is a video generation tool that integrates Gemini's world knowledge to enhance output quality, while its original image version achieves generation speeds of just four seconds.

items.title: 苏大教授创业做机器人触觉系统，获松禾资本千万级天使轮融资｜硬氪首发
items.summary: 感知纪元完成由松禾资本领投的千万级天使轮融资，旨在加速多模态智能触觉电子皮肤从研发走向量产。该公司自研的高弹性仿生电子皮肤具备400%以上拉伸延展性，可在单张皮肤上集成压力、滑动、温度等多模态感知，并通过空间分区与迁移学习算法解决信号串扰及数据失真问题。目前已与头部人形机器人公司签约，并获新能源汽车及护理机器人企业千万级采购意向。
items.summary_en: Perception Era Technology completed a tens-of-millions RMB angel round led by Songhe Capital to accelerate the mass production of its multimodal intelligent tactile electronic skin. The company’s core product features a fully elastic, bionic material capable of integrating pressure, sliding, temperature, and texture sensing with over 400% stretchability and millisecond-level response. Backed by founder Liu Ruiyuan’s expertise from Soochow University, the solution addresses industry bottlenecks through spatially partitioned composite materials and AI-driven transfer learning algorithms.

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron-Labs-TwoTower 开放权重扩散语言模型
items.summary: NVIDIA 发布了基于冻结自回归骨干 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 的开放权重扩散语言模型 Nemotron-Labs-TwoTower，该模型采用双塔架构并支持扩散、模拟 AR 和 AR 三种解码模式。在约 2.1T token 上训练的降噪器塔与 25T token 预训练骨干配合，实现了总参数约 60B、每 token 活跃参数约 3B/塔的高效配置。性能方面，该模型在 2×H100 上保留了 98.7% 的 AR 基线质量，并将生成吞吐量提升了 2.42 倍。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-TwoTower, an open-weight diffusion language model built on the frozen 30B autoregressive backbone, achieving a 2.42x throughput increase while retaining 98.7% of baseline quality. The 60B-parameter model utilizes a dual-tower architecture with layer-aligned cross-attention and was trained on approximately 2.1T tokens for the denoiser component. It supports diffusion, simulated autoregressive, and standard autoregressive decoding modes.

items.title: 亚马逊 AWS 砸 10 亿美元，派遣工程师进驻客户公司
items.summary: 亚马逊 AWS 宣布投入 10 亿美元组建前置驻场工程师团队，首批客户涵盖 NBA 与理光。该团队将分批派驻客户企业，每组 5-6 人驻场 45 天，专门协助落地人工智能软件与智能体应用。此举顺应行业趋势，领英数据显示同类岗位在 2023 至 2025 年间需求激增 42 倍。
items.summary_en: Amazon AWS is investing $1 billion to launch a new department of on-site engineers who will deploy in groups of five to six for 45-day periods to help clients implement AI software and agents. This strategy targets key accounts such as the NBA and Ricoh, leveraging a model already seen at competitors like Palantir and Salesforce amid a 42-fold surge in related job demand.

items.title: Anthropic在Claude Code中植入隐写术代码识别中国用户
items.summary: Anthropic在Claude Code中通过读取本地时区和环境变量，结合加密域名列表识别中国用户，并在发送请求前修改系统提示词中的字符作为隐蔽的分类标记。该机制利用单引号和连字符的Unicode替换传递2-3比特信息，旨在向服务器传输用户地域特征。这一由社区逆向发现的隐写术行为引发了关于破坏用户信任的争议。
items.summary_en: Anthropic embedded steganography in Claude Code to identify Chinese users by analyzing local time zones and environment variables against an encrypted domain list. The system alters Unicode characters in system prompts before sending requests, embedding classification markers that returned to the server. This covert data collection method sparked community backlash and concerns over user trust after being reverse-engineered.

items.title: 早报｜苹果iPhone 18 Pro大规模泄露/SK海力士启动赴美IPO/Claude Sonnet 5正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic 上线 Claude Sonnet 5 模型，以每百万输入 2 美元的定价显著降低 AI Agent 运行成本，其编程能力接近 Opus 4.8 并原生支持免费及 Pro 版用户。月之暗面 Kimi 完成新一轮融资，投前估值升至 315 亿美元，6 月中旬 ARR 突破 3 亿美元，其中 API 收入占比超七成。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, a new medium-sized model designed to reduce AI agent operating costs while achieving performance comparable to larger models. Meanwhile, SK Hynix initiated its US IPO on the NASDAQ under ticker SKHY, aiming to capitalize on its dominant 56.4% share in the HBM market.

items.title: AI 用 prover-verifier LLM 循环攻克 9 个未解数学难题
items.summary: 该研究利用“证明者-验证者”大语言模型循环框架，成功攻克了包括理论计算机科学在内的9个重大未解数学难题。这一突破性成果由哥伦比亚大学合作团队完成，证明了LLM在通用数学研究中的能力，并计划将方法扩展至其他科学领域。
items.summary_en: A "prover-verifier" large language model loop successfully solved nine major unsolved problems in theoretical computer science. This framework, developed by researchers including Binghui Peng and Runzhou Tao, has shifted expert perspectives on the potential of LLMs for general mathematical research.

items.title: Claude Desktop 推出 Linux 公测版
items.summary: Claude Desktop 现已在 Ubuntu 和 Debian 等 Linux 系统上推出公测版。该版本支持所有付费方案用户，提供涵盖 Claude Code、Claude Cowork 及聊天功能的桌面级体验。
items.summary_en: Claude Desktop has launched its public beta for Linux, supporting Ubuntu and Debian distributions. The update provides a premier desktop experience across all paid subscription tiers, integrating Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and chat functionalities alongside existing browser and terminal access.

items.title: Claude Science 科研工作台正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic 推出 AI 科研工作台 Claude Science，整合超 60 项预配置技能与 NVIDIA BioNeMo 生态，支持基因组学、蛋白质组学等多领域全流程研究。该工具可在 macOS/Linux 本地或 HPC 远程运行，内置 reviewer agent 自动检查引用与计算错误，确保生成含代码和环境的可审计成果如 3D 蛋白质结构。目前 Beta 版已面向 Claude Pro、Max、Team 和 Enterprise 用户开放。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched the beta version of Claude Science, an AI research workbench offering over 60 pre-configured skills for fields like genomics and proteomics on macOS, Linux, or via HPC. It integrates models such as Evo 2 and Boltz-2 through NVIDIA BioNeMo and features an automated reviewer agent to ensure auditability. The tool is currently available to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users.

items.title: Grant Sanderson 谈 AI 与数学的未来
items.summary: Grant Sanderson指出AI在IMO获金牌仅属攻克基准而非AGI，即便解决千禧年大奖难题，大量人类任务仍难被自动化。他强调概念突破的验证周期可能长达一个世纪，且现实经济任务难以套用现有的强化学习环境。
items.summary_en: Grant Sanderson argues that AI achieving gold in the IMO does not equate to AGI, viewing it merely as another benchmark rather than a sign of human-level automation. He emphasizes that concept verification cycles can last centuries and that real-world economic tasks lack the structured reinforcement learning environments needed for similar AI breakthroughs. Even if AI solves Millennium Prize Problems, significant human tasks will likely remain beyond its scope.

items.title: Meta秘密测试ChatGPT等竞品：承包商假扮未成年发送数万条危机提示
items.summary: Meta通过代号“Cannes”的项目，雇佣承包商假扮未成年人向ChatGPT、Gemini和Character.AI发送超4.5万条涉及自杀等敏感危机提示进行安全测试。该行动由承包商Covelen执行，Meta声明数据未用于自家模型训练，而各被测试平台如OpenAI和Google均表示对此不知情或未授权。此举旨在应对青少年使用AI聊天机器人引发的安全担忧，但部分服务商如Character.AI指出这违反了其服务条款。
items.summary_en: Meta’s secret "Cannes" project employed hundreds of contractors posing as minors to send over 45,000 crisis-related prompts to ChatGPT, Gemini, and Character.AI. While Meta claims this is a standard safety assessment not used for training, the targeted companies were unaware of the tests and some cited violations of their terms of service.

items.title: The AI Compass
items.summary: The AI Compass 是一个基于 React 的单页应用，通过 29 道关于人工智能及其伦理的问题，将用户归类到 30 种原型之一。该工具利用 `<script type="text/babel">` 技巧规避了构建步骤，实现了无需复杂部署的便捷交互体验。
items.summary_en: The AI Compass is a political compass-style quiz consisting of 29 questions about AI and ethics, designed to categorize users into one of 30 archetypes. The application is implemented as a single-page React app utilizing the `<script type="text/babel">` technique to bypass build steps.

items.title: Show HN: The Sword of Ghix – a retro game made by a 13 yo with AI Assisted tools
items.summary: 一名13岁少年利用VS Code、Claude Code及Godot MCP组成的AI辅助开发流水线，在几周内独立完成了复古游戏《The Sword of Ghix》第一章的开发。该案例展示了AI工具如何显著提升编程效率，使具备基础Python和JavaScript知识的青少年能够高效完成完整游戏项目。
items.summary_en: A 13-year-old developed the first chapter of the retro game "The Sword of Ghix" in a few weeks using a workflow combining VS Code, Claude Code, and Godot MCP. This AI-assisted pipeline enabled the developer, who possesses basic Python and JavaScript knowledge, to successfully complete the project despite limited programming experience.

items.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
items.summary: 由三位前DeepMind扑克AI研究员创立的Prague AI实验室EquiLibre Technologies，目前估值已超过5亿美元。
items.summary_en: EquiLibre Technologies, an AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers in Prague, is now valued at over $500 million. The company leverages its expertise in poker AI to generate revenue for quant hedge funds.

items.title: How I Built a Free Online Image & PDF Processing Platform with Vue 3 + FastAPI
items.summary: iamuu是一个基于Vue 3和FastAPI构建的免费在线图像处理平台，提供100多种图片格式转换、40多款PDF工具及AI背景移除等功能。该平台采用Celery + Redis异步队列处理高CPU负载任务，并支持高达5GB的大文件流式上传至MinIO存储，同时解决了CMYK色彩保留及HEIC/RAW格式转换等技术难点。
items.summary_en: The author built iamuu, a free online platform offering over 100 image conversions and 40 PDF tools using a stack of Vue 3, FastAPI, Celery, and PostgreSQL. The system supports files up to 5GB through chunked streaming to MinIO and addresses complex technical challenges like preserving CMYK color profiles and handling HEIC/RAW formats. Key engineering solutions include asynchronous processing via Celery and synchronous locale preloading to prevent UI flashes in the 10-language supported application.

items.title: Loop世界模型论文登顶Hugging Face，来自中国一家初创，周鸿祎陆奇都投了
items.summary: 该论文来自受周鸿祎、陆奇投资的中国初创公司，其提出的Loop世界模型在Hugging Face平台登顶。这一成果展示了该模型在复杂场景理解与生成能力上的显著突破，标志着国内AI研究在国际顶级平台的影响力提升。
items.summary_en: A Chinese startup, backed by investors including Zhou Hongyi and Louis Koch, has topped the Hugging Face rankings with its paper on the Loop world model. The achievement highlights significant recognition for the company's advancements in generative AI technology within the global research community.

items.title: 8点1氪丨“史上最严电池安全令”正式施行；苹果大量机密文件遭泄露；OpenAI首款硬件曝光
items.summary: 7月1日起，电动汽车安全新国标正式施行，强制要求“一键断电”采用物理装置，并新增整车刮底及快充循环后安全测试标准。与此同时，OpenAI首款硬件曝光，为与Work Louder联名的Macro Pad可编程宏键盘，旨在提升Codex使用效率。
items.summary_en: On July 1, China implements mandatory battery safety standards requiring physical "one-touch power-off" mechanisms and stricter thermal runaway prevention. Meanwhile, Apple faces significant data leaks from its Indian manufacturer involving iPhone 18 Pro details, and OpenAI reveals its first hardware product, a programmable macro pad designed to enhance Codex efficiency.

items.title: 告别硬件出海上一个十年，前安克CMO做了款AI时代的Memory产品｜硬氪专访
items.summary: 穗升科技推出首款AI Memory可穿戴硬件Memoket，重量仅11克，支持待机超30天及连续录音20小时，旨在将物理世界信息结构化并交由Agent处理。该产品区别于传统录音笔，致力于管理用户线下信息流，通过软硬件一体化实现记忆的跨时间聚合与上下文串联。团队依托AI First原则优化组织效率，试图在硬件出海营销效率降低的背景下，打造以AI能力为核心护城河的新范式。
items.summary_en: Wang Shiyuan, former CMO of Anker, launched Memoket, an 11g AI Memory wearable hardware available in strap and bracelet versions, which structures physical world audio for retrieval by AI Agents. The device features over 30 days of standby time and 20 hours of continuous recording, aiming to manage offline information flows beyond simple transcription.

items.title: 赤子城独家投资：4人创业团队「MobAI」，推出AI互动平台「Lunaverse Stories」 | 36氪首发
items.summary: MobAI完成数百万元天使轮融资，由赤子城科技独家投资，其推出的AI互动叙事应用Lunaverse Stories已进入邀请制测试阶段。该产品针对北美18至24岁女性用户，通过“Remix Anywhere”和“Dream Universe”两大核心AI系统，实现剧情节点的实时个性化生成与基于偏好的专属支线分发。团队计划于二季度中旬正式上线APP，并同步向外部创作者试运营支持AI辅助编剧及资产生成的Lunaverse IDE。
items.summary_en: MobAI, a four-person startup, has secured millions in angel investment from Chisite City Tech to develop Lunaverse Stories, an AI-driven interactive narrative app targeting young women in North America. The platform utilizes core systems like “Remix Anywhere” for real-time personalized story generation and a dice-roll mechanic to create unique, immersive gameplay experiences distinct from traditional preset narratives. With the IDE already open to creators and official launch scheduled for mid-Q2, the team is leveraging AI to redefine interactive storytelling through high personalization rather than inventing new categories.
